prompt:
Look at the bead-loop puzzle in the image: an outline-style reference bead loop above several labeled option loops. How many option loops match the reference loop up to rotation only, while keeping the bead order around the loop unchanged? Return the count of option loops with the same cyclic bead pattern, including color and shape, as an integer.
Return a valid JSON object with keys "evidence" and "answer" in that order.
Evidence rule: set "evidence" to an array containing one bounding box [x1, y1, x2, y2] for each valid option image, ordered from left to right and then top to bottom.
Answer rule: set "answer" to the exact number of valid option loops as an integer.
Example JSON:
{"evidence":[[574,671,746,825]],"answer":1}
